cuda_gate_probe.scope: Bounded component check on the published ARM64 image; not full-model startup qualification.
cuda_gate_probe.condition: Automatic cyclic collection during a CUDA stream-gated measurement, using the installed B12X source and CuTe library finalizer.
cuda_gate_probe.measurement: Library unload completed successfully after the stream gate released, without watchdog intervention or source overlays.
cuda_gate_probe.result: The installed collection-deferral guard prevents the reproduced cyclic-finalizer gate deadlock.
cuda_gate_probe.limitations: Explicit gc.collect(), reference-count finalizers and unrelated driver stalls are not covered.
